title: 第96章 林国栋和徐青青的歪主意

第96章 林国栋和徐青青的歪主意-《重生80，分家后带妻女吃香喝辣》

林国栋蹲在她旁边，堆着笑脸：“青青，我错了。

那天我喝了酒，嘴上没把门的。

你别跟我一般见识。”

徐青青把玉米往筐里一扔：“林国栋，我跟你说实话。

你大哥开了杂货铺，一个月好歹挣个五六十块。

你二哥开了大饭店，一个月挣多少你心里有数。

就你，三天打鱼两天晒网，跑运输嫌累，种地嫌苦，你还能干啥？”

林国栋脸上的笑挂不住了。

“我也想做生意，不是没本钱嘛。”

徐青青等的就是他这句话。

她往林国栋跟前凑了凑，压低声音：“本钱的事，我帮你想好了。”

林国栋抬起头。

“美丽那儿，不是有笔赔偿金吗？八百块呢。”

林国栋脸色变了：“青青，那是美丽拿命换的钱……”

“谁说白拿了？咱们是借，等生意赚了钱，连本带利还给她。

她一个离了婚的女人，拿着那笔钱也是存银行。

存银行才几个利息？借给咱，咱给她高利息，不比存银行强？”

林国栋不吭声。

徐青青见他松动，又加了一把火：“你想啊，你要是借了这笔钱，做个买卖赚了钱，以后在林家谁还敢瞧不起你？

大哥开杂货铺了不起？二哥开饭店了不起？你赚了钱，他们得跟在你屁股后头跑。

到时候爹妈也得高看你一眼，你才是林家最有出息的儿子。”

林国栋的喉结动了动。

林家最有出息的儿子。

这几个字像火苗一样，噌地窜进他心里。

他想起爹看他的眼神，想起妈沉默的那半天，想起上回被二哥按在墙上揍，他连还手都不敢。

要是他有了钱，开了店，当了大老板……谁还敢瞧不起他？

“再说了。”徐青青声音软下来，拿手指戳了他胳膊一下，“你要是把这事办成了，晚上……你想怎么样，我都由着你。”

林国栋眼睛亮起火苗，腾地站起来。

“行！我这就去找美丽！”

徐青青眉开眼笑：“这就对了嘛，我在家等你，你快去快回。”

林国栋骑上自行车，蹬得飞快。

来的时候他觉得这八里地真远，回去的时候他恨不得蹬得更快些。

风刮在脸上，他一点不觉得冷，心里那把火烧得旺旺的。

林美丽的住处，他只知道大概位置。

镇子边上，挨着纺织厂，一片老房子。

他骑到那片，打听了好几个人，才找到林美丽租的那间小屋。

一间南房，窗户上糊着旧报纸，门口用碎砖头垒了个小灶台。

林美丽正蹲在门口生火，左手还不太能使力，用右手一根一根往灶膛里添柴。

看见林国栋推着自行车过来，她愣了一下。

“三哥？你咋来了？”

Lin Guodong squatted next to her with a smile on his face: "Qingqing, I was wrong.

I drank wine that day and kept my mouth shut.

Don't be the same as me."

Xu Qingqing threw the corn into the basket: "Lin Guodong, let me tell you the truth.

Your eldest brother opened a grocery store and earned fifty or sixty yuan a month.

Your second brother has opened a big restaurant, and you know how much he earns in a month.

It’s just you, you spend three days fishing and two days drying nets, running for transportation is too tiring, and farming is hard, what else can you do?"

Lin Guodong couldn't hold back the smile on his face.

"I also want to do business, but I don't have the capital."

What Xu Qingqing was waiting for was his words.

She moved closer to Lin Guodong and lowered her voice: "I will help you think about the capital matter."

Lin Guodong raised his head.

"Meili, isn't there a compensation? Eight hundred yuan."

Lin Guodong's expression changed: "Qingqing, that's the money that Beauty sacrificed her life for..."

"Who said she got it for free? We are borrowing it, and when the business makes money, we will return it to her with interest.

She was a divorced woman, and she kept the money in the bank.

How much interest does it cost to deposit in the bank?Lend it to us and we'll give her a high interest rate. Isn't it better than depositing it in the bank?"

Lin Guodong remained silent.

Seeing that he was relaxed, Xu Qingqing added fire: "Think about it, if you borrow this money and make money from business, who in the Lin family will dare to look down on you in the future?

Is it great for my eldest brother to open a grocery store?Is it great for my second brother to open a restaurant?You make money, and they have to run after you.

When the time comes, your parents will have to take a high look at you. You are the most promising son of the Lin family."

Lin Guodong's Adam's apple moved.

The most promising son of the Lin family.

These words were like flames, rushing into his heart.

He remembered the way his father looked at him, the half-day period when his mother was silent, and the last time his second brother pushed him against the wall and beat him, and he didn't even dare to fight back.

If he had money, opened a store, and became a big boss...who would dare to look down on him?

"Besides." Xu Qingqing's voice softened and she poked his arm with her finger. "If you get this done, tonight... I'll let you do whatever you want."

Lin Guodong's eyes lit up and he stood up.

"Okay! I'll go find Meili right now!"

Xu Qingqing smiled happily: "That's right. I'll wait for you at home. You go and come back quickly."

Lin Guodong got on his bicycle and pedaled very fast.

When he came here, he felt that eight miles was really far away. When he came back, he wished he could pedal faster.

The wind blew on his face, but he didn't feel cold at all, and the fire in his heart was burning brightly.

He only knew the approximate location of Lin Meili's residence.

On the edge of the town, next to the textile factory, is a cluster of old houses.

He rode there and asked several people before he found the cabin Lin Meili rented.

In a south room, the windows were covered with old newspapers, and a small stove was built with broken bricks at the door.

Lin Meili was squatting at the door to light the fire. She couldn't use her left hand very well, so she used her right hand to add firewood to the stove one by one.

She was stunned for a moment when she saw Lin Guodong pushing his bicycle.

"Third brother? Why are you here?"
